title: [review] slot_claim.py:172: Slot values not validated
description: from_cbor() accepts any values in the slots array and relies on implicit type errors during sorting. Negative slot indices pass validation (e.g., slots=(-1, 0, 1) is accepted) but are invalid per the spec since slots represent indices in [0, max_slots). Non-integer types like strings cause confusing errors during sorted() comparison rather than clear type validation errors.
